name: Fish tacos
intro: San Diego's taco, made with this month's fish. Seared, not fried, and finished in the time it takes to warm the tortillas.

variations.context: The October fish taco. The pomegranate is the salsa.
Smokier. Smear the jar on the tortilla first.
No fish this week. Same tortillas, same finish.

finish: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until they blister in spots, and stack them under a towel. Two per taco. Pomegranate and lime go on last, so they stay cold and bright against the warm fish.
